text:
Jordan: Heads-up: doing a low-risk canary tonight 22:00-23:00 UTC. Target services: api v5.1 (pinned), runtime v2.3.1 (minor patch), console v1.8.1 (feature-flagged), router v3.2.1. Plan is staggered: runtime -> router -> console. I want explicit ack on routing pins and revert steps.

deploy-bot: /deploy canary runtime:v2.3.1 --stages=runtime,router,console --window=22:00-23:00UTC --canary=4% --auto-rollback=true
Checklist: liveness/startup probes, distributed tracing enabled, canary label set. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/canary-nightly

Priya: runtime v2.3.1 fixes a pacing bug in continuous batching and toggles an internal kernel path. Perf tests good but we should watch tail-latency (p95/p99). I can add a short smoke job that hits heavy prompt paths after runtime deploy.

Marcus: router change is a soft-pref upgrade. It adds a "prefer-runtime" mapping keyed by X-RW-Route header. Need to ensure console sends header in canary, otherwise router falls back to legacy routing. Does console feature flag enable header at canary scope?

Elena: console has endpoint-level flag `enableHeaderSplit`. I can enable it for the canary user group only. I'll post the flag change command here once applied.

Jordan: Please do that. Also, lock API at v5.1 for the window and do not flip API rolling updates. We want stable upstream contract while we exercise runtime+router+console.

Marcus: Will push a temporary router map: `routerctl apply --env=prod --map=prefer-runtime-canary.yaml`. Map will prefer runtime:v2.3.1 for any request with header X-RW-Canary: true. Link to diff: https://internal.redwood/changes/4809

deploy-bot: Canary preflight checks: all services have deployment artifacts, smoke test container images signed, traffic steering config present. Proceeding to stage: runtime.

Priya: runtime deployed to canary ring. Smoke job running: hitting model-heavy prompts. First run: p50/p95 within baseline, p99 +12% (small). Watching for stability for 10m.

ops-bot: Alert: trace-sampler config updated for canary label. Temporary dashboard tile created: /dashboards/canary-crossservice-latency

Elena: Feature flag enabled for canary cohort: `enableHeaderSplit=true` for group:canary. Console will send `X-RW-Canary: true` for cohort traffic.

Marcus: Router map applied. Current routing: prefer runtime:v2.3.1 -> fallback route-v2.2 if header missing. Confirmed that router will not send to older runtime unless header absent.

Jordan: Important: ensure the fallback path does NOT end up on runtime v2.2 for requests that were supposed to be canary. Can we pin fallback to a safe variant?

Marcus: Adjusted fallback mapping to route unknown headers to runtime:stable (v2.2.9) which has the same API semantics but will exclude canary features. That keeps behavior predictable.

Priya: After 12m of canary runtime traffic: p50 stable, p95 +3%, p99 steady. No 5xx. I'll hold 5 more minutes then give go-ahead to router stage.

deploy-bot: Runtime stage pass -> proceeding to router stage. Canary still at 4%.

Marcus: Router roll applied to canary ring. Observability: routing logs show header present for 96% of canary requests. 4% missing header likely from older clients; those go to fallback.

Elena: Console canary config is staged but will not go live until we confirm router shape. Keeping feature-flag toggle ready for immediate revert.

Jordan: Rollback thresholds for tonight: abort if (1) p50 inference latency > 30% for 10m, (2) p99 cross-service latency > 50% for 5m, (3) 5xx > 1% absolute for 5m, or (4) error budget burn > 40% in a 15m window. Any additions?

Priya: Add one more: if model output error-rate (invalid responses) increases > 0.5% absolute for 10m, rollback. I'll monitor eval hooks.

Jordan: Good call. Also, manual hold at any time by team leads. If anyone shouts hold, we stop promotion and rollback.

deploy-bot: Router stage pass -> ready to stage console. Canary traffic still 4%. No automated rollbacks triggered.

Elena: Enabling console canary flag now for cohort. Command: `flags set enableHeaderSplit --cohort=canary --on`

Marcus: Observability: end-to-end traces show header present and routing acting on header. No increase in 5xx.

deploy-bot: Console stage done. Canary complete at 4% for 25 minutes. No auto-rollback.

Jordan: Thanks all. Next step: bump to 25% for 30m then 100% if stable. I'll escalate once 25% holds. Post any anomalies here with metric + minute marker.

ops-bot: Reminder: please ensure release notes include revert steps and feature-flag commands. Suggested note: "To revert router mapping: `routerctl rollback prefer-runtime-canary`"

Elena: Draft release notes: https://internal.redwood/notes/2189 - includes feature-flag toggles and revert snippet.

Jordan: Great. Stand by for 25% promotion in ~10m.
